verdict.rationale: Superpowers batches small same-shape tasks into one subagent dispatch, with batch reviews checking that every file in the brief reached the diff. `/execute-plan` runs batched implementation plans, and agents can work through many plan tasks autonomously for hours. However, batching is an internal cost optimization within plan execution rather than a user-directed bulk-operation feature, and the core subagent flow dispatches tasks one by one. Missing for 10: an explicit user-facing way to apply one operation across many items or files at once, documented limits or scale of batching, and independent or hands-on corroboration of batch execution.
